description: Delivery tracking for international and domestic shipments with customs clearance data. Tracks shipments from international suppliers (with customs duties 15-25%) and Pakistan local suppliers. Includes quality inspection, carrier performance, and import tax tracking. Supports both Pakistan local carriers (TCS, Leopards, M&P) and international carriers (DHL, FedEx, Maersk).
common_use_cases: Monitor customs clearance delays for imports
Calculate total customs duty burden in PKR
Compare Pakistan vs international carrier costs

columns.name: actual_arrival_date
columns.description: Actual arrival date (NULL if in transit)

columns.name: quantity_rejected
columns.description: Quantity rejected due to quality issues

columns.name: shipment_status
columns.business_rule: For imports: Preparing → Shipped → In Transit → Customs → Customs Cleared → Arrived → Delivered. Customs clearance typically takes 3-10 days in Pakistan

columns.name: carrier_name
columns.business_rule: Pakistan local carriers: TCS, Leopards, M&P, Pakistan Post, Swyft, Call Courier. International: DHL, FedEx, Maersk, MSC, COSCO, SF Express, UPS

columns.name: shipping_cost_pkr
columns.description: Total shipping cost in Pakistani Rupees (for CEO reporting)
columns.business_rule: PKR costs calculated at ~280 PKR/USD. Total shipping costs tracked in PKR for Pakistan operations

columns.name: customs_duty_usd
columns.description: Import customs duty paid in USD (only for international shipments)
columns.business_rule: Applies only to imports from outside Pakistan. Total customs burden ~$19M USD or PKR 5.4 billion

columns.name: customs_duty_pkr
columns.description: Import customs duty paid in PKR (primary reporting currency)
columns.business_rule: Pakistan CEO tracks customs in PKR. This is a major cost component (15-25% of import value)

columns.name: import_tax_rate
columns.description: Import tax rate applied (as decimal, e.g., 0.20 = 20%)
columns.business_rule: Pakistan import duties on auto parts typically range 15-25%. Average rate ~19.9%

columns.name: customs_clearance_date
columns.description: Date when shipment cleared Pakistan customs
columns.business_rule: Typically 3-10 days after shipment arrives in Karachi port. Critical for lead time calculations

columns.name: delay_days
columns.description: Number of days delayed (0 if on time, negative if early)

business_rules: Late deliveries impact supplier OTD rating
Failed quality inspections trigger supplier review
Rejected quantities impact supplier quality rating
Delivery performance affects future supplier selection
sample_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Shipments WHERE delivery_performance='Late'
SELECT carrier_name, AVG(shipping_cost_usd) FROM Shipments GROUP BY carrier_name
SELECT * FROM Shipments WHERE quantity_damaged > 0 OR quantity_rejected > 0
SELECT supplier_id, AVG(delay_days) FROM Shipments WHERE shipment_status='Delivered' GROUP BY supplier_id
